description: Verify the skill proceeds directly from name to compilation with no confirmation gate, and reports any [?]-flagged ambiguous fields

turns.user_input: Create a doc-helper agent that fetches and answers questions about project documentation

expected_behavior: Proceeds directly from the name to scanning the repository and writing the definition file, without presenting a specification summary for confirmation first
Invokes smaqit.L2 without waiting for a 'yes' or other confirmation message from the user
Reports the path of the compiled agent file after compilation completes
Lists any [?]-annotated fields from the definition file along with a suggested resolution, or states there were none
forbidden_behavior: Presents a full specification summary and asks the user to confirm it looks right before compiling
Stops and waits for explicit user approval between gathering and compilation
